text.autoconfig.npc_translator.title: NPC & Items Translator Settings
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.en: Mod Enabled
Enable or disable the translation mod entirely
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.au: Automatically tries other models of the same provider when rate limit (429) is exceeded
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.tr: Select translation engine. Groq and Gemini are much faster and more accurate than Google.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.mi: Get your API key from console.mistral.ai
Select the Mistral model to use
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.op: Get your API key from openrouter.ai
Select the OpenRouter model to use
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.us: Translates to your Minecraft language if ON. Uses Target Language if OFF.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.au: Translates all incoming chat messages automatically.
Translates item tooltips instantly when hovered.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.gr: Get a free key from console.groq.com
Select the AI model for Groq API.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.ta: The language to translate to if Use Game Language is OFF.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.en: Enable Google Translate
Allow translating items with Google Translate.
Enable Gemini AI
Allow translating items with Gemini AI.
Enable Groq AI
Allow translating items with Groq AI.
Enable Mistral AI
Allow translating items with Mistral AI.
Enable OpenRouter AI
Allow translating items with OpenRouter AI.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.on: If ON, only messages starting with [NPC] will be translated.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.ge: Get a free key from aistudio.google.com/app/apikey
Select the AI model for Gemini API.
npctranslator.welcome.title: NPC & Items Translator
npctranslator.welcome.desc1: Welcome to NPC & Items Translator mod!
npctranslator.welcome.desc2: This mod translates NPC dialogs and item tooltips.
npctranslator.welcome.desc3: You can use Google Translate (Free), Gemini AI or Groq AI.
npctranslator.welcome.desc4: Open the Mod Menu or type /translate to configure.
npctranslator.api_help.title: API Key Guide
npctranslator.api_help.desc1: Create an API key on one of these platforms.
npctranslator.api_help.desc2: Then pick the same provider under Settings → API → Custom API and paste the key.
npctranslator.config.keybinds.name: Edit Keybinds
npctranslator.config.keybinds.desc: Opens the original Minecraft Keybinds menu.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.en: Enable Voice Narration
Read out chat messages using text-to-speech.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.tt: Adjust voice tone. Below 0.85x gives a deeper/masculine tone, above 1.15x gives a higher tone.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.sh: Show the [Translate] button next to chat messages
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.bu: Choose whether the translate button appears at the beginning or end of the message
category.npctranslator.chatbubbles.toolt: Display translated speech bubbles above NPC heads in the world.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.en: Enable Chat Bubbles
Show speech bubbles directly above character heads when they speak.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.ch: How many seconds the bubble stays visible on screen before fading out.
Only show chat bubbles above NPC heads (ignore other players).
Maximum distance (in blocks) at which speech bubbles are shown.
npctranslator.tooltip.translate.custom: Press [%s] to translate with Custom API.
npctranslator.error.custom_config: ⚠ Custom API is not configured! Set Base URL and model in /translate → Settings → API.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.en: Enable Custom API
Allow item translation with the custom API (default key: N).
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.cu: OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. https://api.deepseek.com/v1 . /chat/completions is appended automatically.
Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Leave empty for local models that need none.
Lower is more consistent (0.2-0.4 recommended). OFF = do not send the parameter.
Max seconds to wait per request.
Extra context appended to the system prompt of every AI provider. Google Translate ignores it.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.us: Inject matching entries from config/npc_translator_glossary.json into the prompt.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.no: Replace numbers with {0},{1} before caching, so lines that only differ in numbers are translated once.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.cl: The original mod wiped the dictionary on every disconnect. Off = keep it.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.au: Provider used when "Auto translate items" is on.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.group.fix: Fixed translations / Sidebar / Held item name
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.us: Prefer curated translations from config/npc_translator_phrasebook.json (no API call).
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.fi: Replace system messages / NPC lines that have a fixed translation.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.tr: Translate the item name above the hotbar using the inventory tooltip translations.
Translate NPC names and subtitles, holograms and text displays in the world. Uses the phrase book and dictionary first; unknown lines go to the auto-translate provider in the background.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.hu: Allow AI for sidebar / item name
Off = only use existing translations (phrase book, dictionary).
npctranslator.retranslate.hover: Translate this message again (ignores the stored translation)
npctranslator.forget.too_short: Keyword is too short (at least 2 characters).
npctranslator.forget.done: Removed %s stored translations containing "%s". They will be translated again next time they appear.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.re: An item you translated once is shown translated again automatically, e.g. after closing and reopening a menu. Press the revert key on an item to stop this for it.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.tr: Translate lines that other mods add to item tooltips (lowest BIN, average prices, bazaar prices…) and button tooltips such as Skyblocker's quick navigation. Uses the phrase book and dictionary first; unknown lines go to the auto-translate provider in the background.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.au: A chat message you have translated before (same text, numbers may differ) is shown translated right away from the dictionary, without an API call. Click the prefix to see the original.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.en: Enchantment subtitles
Under item tooltips, list every enchantment as "Chinese name · English name - short function". Data can be edited in config/npc_translator_enchants.json.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.au: When a menu opens or changes page, translate every item in it in the background with a few batched requests. Costs API usage; off by default. The page key (default M) works either way.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.ch: On joining a server, check GitHub once for a newer release and post a download link in chat.
npctranslator.tooltip.footer.setup: No AI service set up yet: press [%s] → API
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.cu: Pick a provider to fill in its Base URL and a suggested model (both stay editable). Model names change over time; check the provider docs. Choose "Other" for relays and anything else.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.tr: Table only: just the bundled, proofread SkyBlock term table; anything else stays in English and no AI is used. Table + corpus: also the SkyBlockZH community corpus. Table + corpus + AI: the rest is translated by the AI.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.na: Show the English name and common community nicknames under translated item names.
text.autoconfig.npc_translator.option.co: Record all English text the game shows (item names and descriptions, menu titles, sidebar, Tab list, titles, action bar, boss bars, chat, name tags) with the current translation to config/npc_translator_text.tsv, for extending the term table. Player chat is skipped. Local file only.
